meta.title: 相亲信息不对称：怎么判断认知水平
meta.title_en: Information Asymmetry in Dating: How to Gauge Cognitive Level

scenes.title_cn: 信息不对称与三样东西
scenes.title_en: Information asymmetry and the three things you know
scenes.context: 讲者开场：相亲一定会遇到世纪难题——信息不对称，你只能大概知道对方三样东西：颜值、资产存量、家庭背景，但最看重的权重是认知水平。
sentences: 相亲一定会遇到世纪难题，叫信息不对称。
Dating always hits a timeless dilemma: information asymmetry.
世纪难题：timeless dilemma
你大概只能知道对方三样东西：颜值、资产存量、家庭背景。
You can roughly know three things: looks, assets, and family background.
资产存量：asset stock
其中最重要的权重，是这个人认知水平怎么样。
The heaviest weight is this person's cognitive level.
认知水平：cognitive level
paraphrase: 信息不对称 → 只能看到三样
Asymmetry limits you to three visible clues.
综合打分 → 认知权重最高
Cognitive level carries the heaviest weight.
scenes.speak: Dating always hits a timeless dilemma: information asymmetry. You can roughly know three things: looks, assets, and family background. The heaviest weight is this person's cognitive level.

scenes.context: 讲者说明直接问三观、爱好、平时做什么是白问，问不出认知水平，需要一种看起来 nice 的方法破解信息不对称。
sentences: 你总不能直接问他：你的三观是什么？
You can't just ask him: what are your values?
三观：values
下班后做点啥、有什么爱好，问了也是白问。
Asking what he does after work or his hobbies is pointless.
白问：pointless
有没有办法用一种看起来比较 nice 的方法判断认知水平？
Is there a nice-looking way to judge his cognitive level?
看起来 nice：nice-looking
paraphrase: 直接问三观 → 问不出来
Direct questions about values reveal nothing.
需要 nice 方法 → 侧面判断
A subtle angle is needed to size him up.
scenes.speak: You can't just ask him: what are your values? Asking what he does after work or his hobbies is pointless. Is there a nice-looking way to judge his cognitive level?

scenes.title_en: The trick: check his short-video follows
scenes.context: 讲者给出方法：把话题往短视频方向聊，分享你关注的博主后自然反问对方关注哪些账号。关注大长腿小姐姐是扣分项，保存「一步登天的歪歪贴」是严重问题。
sentences: 把话题往短视频方向聊，分享你最近关注的博主。
Steer the topic to short videos and share the creators you follow.
短视频博主：short-video creators
你很自然地问：你平时都关注哪些账号？
You casually ask: which accounts do you usually follow?
自然地问：casually ask
保存超过三条「一步登天的歪歪贴」，说明想走捷径，认知水平很弱。
Saving three-plus get-rich-quick posts reveals a shortcut mentality and weak cognition.
一步登天的歪歪贴：get-rich-quick fantasy posts
paraphrase: Sharing your creators invites his honest answer.
关注内容 → 认知投影
What he follows projects his real desires and cognition.
scenes.speak: Steer the topic to short videos and share the creators you follow. You casually ask: which accounts do you usually follow? Saving three-plus get-rich-quick posts reveals a shortcut mentality and weak cognition.

practice: Dating always hits the problem of information asymmetry.
Cognitive level carries the heaviest weight.
Asking his values directly is pointless.
Saving get-rich-quick posts shows a shortcut mentality.
pitfalls: ✕ 直译腔：The information is not symmetric.
✓ 地道说法：Ask what his values are.
小姐姐在英文语境用 attractive accounts 更得体。
意译为 get-rich-quick 最贴切。
shifts: 从关注内容侧面观察认知
